Who it’s for

Your expertise is real, but your LinkedIn presence does not yet turn it into conversations with the right people.

  • Founders and consultants
  • B2B professionals and coaches
  • Sales and business development leaders

What you’ll learn

  1. Clarify who you serve and what you want to be known for
  2. Plan useful content with AI support, then edit it in your own voice
  3. Design a simple, reviewable follow-up workflow for new conversations

What you leave with

  • A positioning statement
  • A four-week content plan
  • A follow-up workflow you review before anything is sent

Illustrative example. Your output depends on the task you bring.

How it runs

The outline below is the planned flow. Session dates and durations are confirmed with each intake.

  1. Positioning

    Who you serve, the problem you solve and the proof you can show.

  2. Content system

    Turn your expertise into a repeatable plan, drafted with AI and edited by you.

  3. Conversations

    A follow-up workflow that keeps people in the loop without automating the relationship.

Requirements and scope

What you need

  • A LinkedIn profile
  • A laptop and internet connection

Not included

  • Guaranteed leads, followers or revenue
  • Done-for-you content or outreach

Questions about this program

Is this about automating LinkedIn?

No. AI helps you plan and draft. You decide what is published and what is sent.
